name: Tellyport
description:
About This Game

Play as Sally, the granddaughter of a brilliant and eccentric inventor, who invited you to explore her 70s lab, filled with unique inventions. Solve puzzles by crossing TV screens that alter your gravity, size, or both. Observation, manipulation, and thinking are key to progressing!

The player is faced with a challenge: cross all the rooms in Grandma’s workshop using her eccentric inventions. The workshop is filled with mechanisms to master: televisions that serve as portals, doors, and pressure plates capable of altering the state of connected elements, forcing the player to manipulate the environment to move forward.

Tellyport offers an immersive experience in a unique 1970s-inspired atmosphere, punctuated by a vintage soundtrack and a carefully crafted retro-futuristic aesthetic.

GRAVITY MODULE

In the Gravity Module, we will explore the notion of gravity. Everything passing through the TVs will be subjected to the gravity of the exit TV.

Who hasn't dreamed of walking on walls? Well, now you can!

SIZE MODULE

In the size module, we will explore the mechanics of size change, which allows us to change the scale of everything passing through the TVs.

This mechanic lets you access surprising places you've always dreamed of reaching.

Tellyport is a first-person puzzle game created by 19 students.
